| [github.com/otfabric/go-dnp3/secauth](secauth.md) | Package secauth implements the cryptographic core of DNP3 Secure Authentication version 5 (IEEE 1815-2012 clause 7 and A.45): the message authentication codes and the construction of the data they protect. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-dnp3/server](server.md) | Package server is the DNP3 outstation (IEEE 1815-2012). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-dnp3/transport](transport.md) | Package transport is the DNP3 transport function (IEEE 1815-2012 clause 8): it splits application fragments into segments that fit one link frame and reassembles received segments into fragments. |
